items.title: US stocks: US market ends lower, off record highs, as Treasury yields climb
items.summary: The recent trading session on Wall Street saw a decline as US Treasury yields surged, sparking fears over inflation and the escalating debt crisis. This drop followed remarkable highs reached by the S&P 500 and Nasdaq. Concurrently, rising oil prices due to supply issues influenced market sentiment and contributed to a global bond selloff.

items.title: Annual pass takes a toll, transactions dip 5.2% in H1
items.summary: Government data shows toll volume fell 5.2% to 2.13 billion in April-September from 2.25 billion in the year-ago period. Toll revenue rose 6.27% to Rs 42,971.82 crore from Rs 40,433.53 crore in the same period of 2025-26, a much slower pace of growth than in previous years.

items.title: Lakhpati Didi scheme boosts household income: IIM Study
items.summary: The Lakhpati Didi initiative, launched in 2023, aims to enhance women's income and savings in India. Recent studies indicate that household income has increased by 61% since the program's inception. Notably, the number of women-led enterprises has surged by 48% within a year.
